QuestInfo.name: [Lachelein] A Concentration Problem
QuestInfo.0: You'll need a mask from Gray Mask before you can hear Protective Mask's story. Talk to Gray Mask.
QuestInfo.1: You need to defeat 100 Wood Board Alley Citizens in Outlaw's Street 3. Then Gray Mask can concentrate more on making the mask.
QuestInfo.2: Gray Mask completed the mask. It didn't look great but at least it fit!

0.0: Oh no, I'm so sorry. I can't concentrate at all, because of those #rWood Board Alley Citizens#k.
0.1: Could you go quiet them? Slapping down about 100 should do. You'll find many of them in #bOutlaw's Street 3#k.

yes.0: I really can't focus until those noisy hoodlums are dealt with. They're on #bOutlaw's Street 3#k.

1.0: Oh, you took care of them quickly. I finished the mask while you were working.
1.1: Here, take it. It might not look great, but it's more than enough to cover that pretty face of yours.

yes.0: I'm sorry, heh. I'm not very good at this. It's ugly, isn't it?
yes.1: Go talk to Protective Mask now that you have a mask of your own.

default.0: All you need to do is teach 100 Wood Board Alley Citizens a lesson.\r\n
